notes.regions: u0, v0, u1, v1 in ron_kab0 (West Ronfaure, 100): ashlar = coursed wall, plinth = dark heavy blocks, coping = slabs, smooth = dressed blocks, window = one slit window, arcade = a band of arched loopholes, narrow = small ashlar for voussoirs and reveals
notes.yalms: how many yalms the whole texture spans on San d'Oria's own walls
notes.banner: The banner from Tavnazian Safehold (26). The cloth is half the design: its left edge (u 0.008) at both edges of the banner, its right (u 0.43) down the middle, as tb_hata01 mirrors it
notes.door: a closed gate's leaves: the iron-strapped planks of tab_has1 (Misareaux 25), mapped once across the opening
notes.paving: streets and squares: shita1 cobbles (Misareaux 25), repeating every 5.7 yalms as Misareaux lays them
